question: What arises by accumulation and decay?
premises: By accumulation of being, wealth-lord at its decay is all-pervading.
Unseen form, endless; above Brahma, expander, all-pervading.
inference: Accumulation and decay yield all-pervading forms above Brahma.
plain_english: By accumulation of being, the wealth-lord at its decay is all-pervading; unseen form, endless; above Brahma, expander, all-pervading.
